annotations.title: Check Korean amount words against digits

description: Find amounts written both in Korean words and in digits in a contract, quote or IOU, e.g. "일금 일백이십삼만원정(₩1,230,000)" or "1,230,000원(금 일백이십삼만원)", and check that the two agree. Mismatches come back with both values and the correct Korean words for the digits. You can also pass explicit pairs. Use before sending or signing a Korean document with amounts.
